violation_type.title: HRC42.044 - Inspections and Investigations Allowed (26 TAC §HRC42.044 - Inspections and Investigatio)
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the DFPS investigator was not allowed entrance into the operation to conduct the investigation and was denied access to a child's record when requested.
